name: PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday JUNE 11, 2020
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG
3. ROLL CALL: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery, Commissioner Fraza-Saenz, Henderson, and Smith
4. REVIEW OF AGENDA
5. MOTION TO WAIVE FULL READING OF ALL RESOLUTIONS ON THE AGENDA FOR THIS MEETING
6. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS AND ANY ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA
7. CONSENT CALENDAR
Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of May 14, 2020
7
8. PUBLIC HEARINGS
8A. Conditional Use Permit 11-006 Major Modification No. 1 and Site Plan Review 20-004
City of Palmdale, Applicant
A request to complete phase two of Sam Yellen park by approximately 15 acres to include sports courts and landscape amenities located at the southwest corner of Avenue S and Hillcrest Avenue.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-025 approving Conditional Use Permit 11-006 Major Modification No. 1 and Site Plan Review 20-004 and adopt the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program prepared for the project. Clarence "Skip" Smith, Assistant Planner
8A Part 2
8A Part 1
8B. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 20-003
City of Palmdale, Applicant
A request to amend Chapters 17.42 (Medium Residential), 17.43 (Multiple Residential), 17.44 (High Density Residential) and 17.83 (Transition Between Land Uses and Zones) of the Palmdale Municipal Code to clarify open space, refuse, and setback requirements for multi-family residential developments.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-022 recommending City Council approval of Zoning Ordinance Amendment 20-003 and find that the project is not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8B
8C. General Plan Amendment 18-002, Zone Change 18-002, and Site Plan Review 18-005
Mr. Phillip Terry, Applicant
A request to construct an 80-unit townhome development on an approximately five-acre vacant site located on the southeast corner of Avenue S and 42nd Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-023 recommending the City Council approve General Plan Amendment 18-002 and Zone Change 18-002, approving Site Plan Review 18-005 and adopting the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program prepared for the project. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8C
8D. Conditional Use Permit 20-002 and Site Plan Review 20-001
Desert Winds Community Church, Applicant
A request to construct a parking lot and legalize an existing church located at 38117 13th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-2028 approving Conditional Use Permit 20-002 and Site Plan Review 20-001 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Justin Sauder, Associate Planner
8D
8E. Conditional Use Permit 08-01 Major Modification No. 1
Vulcan Materials Company, Applicant
A request to expand an existing surface mining operation (California Mine ID # 91-19-0020) located south of Avenue T and approximately 3,000 feet west of 80th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2019-051 approving Conditional Use Permit 08-01 Major Modification No. 1 and find that the project includes minor alterations to the previously adopted Mitigated Negative Declaration for the previously approved project. Justin Sauder, Associate Planner
8E
8F. Tentative Tract Map 81337
Royal Investors Group, LLC, Applicant
A request to subdivide 40 acres into 86 single-family residential lots located between 65th Street West and 70th Street West approximately 650 feet south of Avenue M.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission continue Tentative Tract Map 81337 to a date uncertain. Justin Sauder, Associate Planner
8F
8G. Conditional Use Permit 16-007 and Site Plan Review 19-007
Mr. Antonio Valles, Applicant
A request for the conversion of an existing single-family residence into an office for a proposed heavy processing facility and the continued use of a portion of the site for outdoor personal storage located at 38939 15th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-030 denying Conditional Use Permit 16-007 and Site Plan Review 19-007. Benjamin Fiss, Senior Planner
8G
8H. Conditional Use Permit 17-017 and Site Plan Review 19-013
Eukon Group, Applicant
A request to construct and operate a major wireless telecommunications facility located at the northeast corner of East Avenue M (Columbia Way) and 50th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: These applications were withdrawn by the applicant. Benjamin Fiss, Senior Planner
8H
9. STAFF COMMUNICATIONS
Carlene Saxton, Acting Planning Manager
10. PLANNING COMMISSION COMMUNICATIONS
11. ADJOURNMENT TO THE REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING OF THURSDAY, JULY 9, 2020, AT 7:00 P.M., IN THE CITY OF PALMDALE CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
